Back on the flats after the non-stop flight from Alaska. Thin, with a dull, worn plumage.
In a flock of several thousand on the Yalu Jiang flats. Deep red breeding plumage.
Roosting on the shell bank at high tide with knots and wrybills.
Feeding at the edge of the incoming tide with a small flock of godwits.
Counted in a mixed flock of godwits and knots. Fat and in full breeding plumage.

On the tundra in a loose group of godwits, feeding on insects.
Roosting near the base of the spit with about 5,000 godwits.
Feeding alone on the sandflat in the estuary, then flew to the roost.
Resighted in a tight flock of red knots on the outer flats.
Feeding on the high-tide roost shell bank. Grey non-breeding plumage.
Bright red, in a flock of red knots on a mudflat island.

Feeding on mudflats beside the seawall construction site.
Moulting into grey plumage on the bay. Flag read from a photograph.
Resighted on the same mudflat as the year before, at the same time in April.
Feeding on the mudflats near the bird observatory with great knots and bar-tailed godwits.
Feeding on mussel beds in the bay with about 300 red knots.
On a beach covered with horseshoe crab eggs. Engraved flag read with a telescope.

In a flock of red knots on the rocky platform at low tide.

Probing for worms in a wet field beside the river, with a small group of godwits.

In a flock of about 1,500 wrybills that wheeled over the shell bank before it landed.
On its nesting territory on the gravel bed, with a mate.
At the high-tide roost in a tight flock of wrybills.
Roosting with a flock of about 800 wrybills and some banded dotterels.
An unusual winter record on the estuary sandbanks, feeding alone.
In a flock of about 400 oystercatchers on the roost.
Back on the riverbed, near the same nest site as the previous year.

Back at its natal barn and feeding young in a nest on a beam.
Resting on a sandbank in the lagoon with common terns.

On its nest on a pylon in the marshes, with a mate.
